summary:
Architectural Plan for Pivoting to TeleSpaces - Dedicated Telegram Voice Chat & Twitter-Style Spaces Client:
1. Telegram Authentication: Phone number login flow with Telegram OTP verification, API ID/Hash integration, and session persistence.
2. Twitter Spaces-Style Voice Rooms: Room code creation & joining, host rules and stage moderation (Host, Co-host, Speakers, Listeners), raise-hand queue, and live emoji reactions.
3. Direct Peer-to-Peer & Group Voice Calling: Dial by Telegram username or contact, incoming/outgoing call overlays, mute/speaker toggles, and live call timers.
4. Real-time Audio Engine: WebRTC voice streams, real-time microphone audio visualizers, active speaker glowing halos, and noise suppression.
5. Android Capacitor Configuration: Full-screen edge-to-edge support, proximity handling, and audio mode control.
